title: WPMS/2321/2017 of Ramdas Gupta AND ANOTHER Vs G. B. Pant University Of Agriculture And Technology AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
Modification Application (MCC No.738 of 2018)
In
WPMS No.2321 of 2017
Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate assisted by
Mr. A.K. Arya, Advocate for the petitioners.
 Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. Devang Dobhal, Advocate for the
respondents.
 Petitioners were tenants of shops at G.B. Pant
University of Agriculture and Technology. Since
they were being evicted by the respondent
University, they filed the present writ petition before
this Court, which was dismissed by this Court vide
order dated 14.09.2017 with the observation that the
respondents had taken the possession from the
petitioners in the year 2015 and the writ petition was
filed in the year 2017.
 Now after a period of more than eight months,
the petitioners have filed a modification application
for the modification/review of the order dated
14.09.2017.
 In view of this Court, this cannot be done as
not only the petitioners have approached this Court
belatedly but they have also not furnished any
plausible reason/ground as to why and under what
circumstances findings of this Court are incorrect.
Although Code of Civil Procedure is not applicable
in a writ petition, but principles of Code of Civil
Procedure are applicable. On consideration of the
limitations given under Order XLVII Rule 1 of the
Code of Civil Procedure, this Court does not find
any ground to modify/review its decision.
There is also no error apparent on the face of
record which may call for interference in the present
modification/review application. Consequently, the
modification application is hereby dismissed.
